write_up: This is a strong match! Your Lumen Ledger work brings together Go payouts, a ledger migration and production reliability, which are central to Cobalt Pay's role. A recruiter has concrete reasons to move this resume forward.

The balance API line is a great model: it names the problem, the technical change and the latency before and after. Your current role leads the resume, and your earlier freight and insurance work adds backend experience without burying the payments story.

For Cobalt, make your role in on-call and technical design reviews more explicit if you can. Also add any work with Finance or Risk on reconciliation and controls if you've done it. The resume is already strong for backend payments roles; those details matter for this particular job.
